body: The thing is that to avoid bugs, we initialize the new value with a space so that it is never empty, and as the procedure is indicated in the doc and therefore when we hover the mouse over the property, people should not have any trouble. Afterwards I agree that the solution is very shaky. My first idea was to add an input below the property so that we could set the left symbol and the right symbol if needed, but I didn't succeed. If you know where the doc is that explains how to change the inputs of a property, send it to me and I'll make a more robust solution.
Turned out to be CodeEdit-specific bug: #107968

After testing, it doesn't work or I do something bad... I changed the line for: 
``` cpp
ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::PACKED_INT32_ARRAY, "line_length_guidelines", PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE, "0,100,1,or_greater"), "set_line_length_guidelines", "get_line_length_guidelines");
```

and this is the result:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15be36cb-06e0-46b0-a834-99bc22b0b7f8)

This check shouldn't be removed, empty prefixes causes problems. 
Inserting the first character of an empty string looks like a bug.
It happens when one prefix is a subset of another, like `" "` and `""" """`, or `##` and `#`.
